main.description: Returns the representative raw entity-follow record, or null, for each requested actor-to-entity relationship. Authentication is not required. Supply 1–100 repeated entities values; the encoded GET request-target must not exceed 7,000 bytes.

actor.description: DID that published the entity-follow records.

entities.description: Full entity AT-URIs using DID authorities, supplied as repeated unbracketed query values. Matching uses the subject URI and ignores CID; every occurrence is returned in request order, including duplicates.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The actor DID, entities array, an entity AT-URI, request-target length, or another query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: EntityFollowQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed entity-follow relationships could not be queried.

results.description: One result per supplied entity occurrence, in request order.

entity.description: Entity AT-URI from the corresponding request occurrence.

follow.description: Earliest indexed matching record by createdAt, with URI ascending on ties, or null when no relationship is indexed. Query failures are errors, not null results.
